notes.title: Late game updates, bugfix
notes.notes:
H!
Several last weeks I fixed bugs that players found. Right now it is stable version.
Plus now in game not 137 levels, but 500) It is pleaser to see players that played more then 150 hours) So even to hardcore players there will be a lot of space for playing. All supporting things for late game changed too.
Thank you for helping me make Hero Rush better!
